title: RGI 7.0 glaciers
description:
One row per glacier: the outline, RGI's attributes, the hypsometry, the links to RGI 6.0 and the GLIMS submission, in one GeoParquet file. The web map archive holds the outlines and the glacier names.

This is an unofficial mirror, not endorsed by the RGI Consortium. The authoritative source is [RGI 7.0 at NSIDC](https://nsidc.org/data/nsidc-0770/versions/7). Citation and credit belong to the RGI Consortium:

> RGI 7.0 Consortium. (2023). *Randolph Glacier Inventory: A dataset of global glacier outlines* (Version 7.0) [Data set]. NSIDC: National Snow and Ice Data Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/F6JMOVY5NAVZ
sci:citation: RGI 7.0 Consortium. (2023). Randolph Glacier Inventory: A dataset of global glacier outlines (Version 7.0) [Data set]. NSIDC: National Snow and Ice Data Center. https://doi.org/10.5067/F6JMOVY5NAVZ

sci:publications.citation: Maussion, F., Hock, R., Paul, F., Raup, B., Rastner, P., Zemp, M., Andreassen, L., Barr, I., Bolch, T., Kochtitzky, W., McNabb, R., & Tielidze, L. (2023). The Randolph Glacier Inventory version 7.0 user guide. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8362857

providers.name: RGI Consortium
providers.description: Produces the Randolph Glacier Inventory, a globally complete inventory of glacier outlines.

providers.name: Luis Q. Gentner
providers.description: Hosts this unofficial mirror. Converts the RGI files to cloud-native formats and maintains this catalog.

table:columns.name: rgi_id
table:columns.description: Unique identifier assigned to a single outline.

table:columns.name: o1region
table:columns.description: The code of the first-order region to which the glacier belongs.

table:columns.name: o2region
table:columns.description: The code of the second-order region to which the glacier belongs.

table:columns.name: glims_id
table:columns.description: Non-unique identifier assigned to glaciers by the Global Land Ice Measurements from Space service at NSIDC.

table:columns.name: anlys_id
table:columns.description: The unique identifier assigned within GLIMS for a particular outline of a glacier at a particular time.

table:columns.name: subm_id
table:columns.description: Unique identifier assigned by GLIMS to a specific data submission. Allows to obtain information about the analysts and data submitters.

table:columns.name: src_date
table:columns.description: The as-of date for the outline (usually the acquisition date of the image), in the format ISO 8601.

table:columns.name: cenlon
table:columns.description: Longitude of an approximately central point within the glacier outlines (not the centroid).

table:columns.name: cenlat
table:columns.description: Latitude of an approximately central point within the glacier outlines (not the centroid).

table:columns.name: utm_zone
table:columns.description: Number of the UTM zone for this glacier, based on its representative point. Note that this attribute is for information only, the geometries are all in WGS84.

table:columns.name: area_km2
table:columns.description: Area of the glacier.

table:columns.name: primeclass
table:columns.description: WGMS primary classification of the glacier. For a categories description, see user guide.

table:columns.name: conn_lvl
table:columns.description: Level of connection to the Greenland Icesheet (0: no connection; 1: weak connection).

table:columns.name: surge_type
table:columns.description: Flag indicating if surging behavior has been documented for this glacier. For a categories description, see user guide.

table:columns.name: term_type
table:columns.description: Flag indicating the terminus type of the glacier. For a categories description, see user guide.

table:columns.name: glac_name
table:columns.description: Glacier name (when available).

table:columns.name: is_rgi6
table:columns.description: Flag indicating if the outline is the same as in RGI 6.0 (1) or was remapped (0). Note that it does not guarantee strict equivalence of the polygon (in most of the cases it does).

table:columns.name: termlon
table:columns.description: Longitude of the lowest elevation point on the glacier outline.

table:columns.name: termlat
table:columns.description: Latitude of the lowest elevation point on the glacier outline.

table:columns.name: zmin_m
table:columns.description: Minimum elevation (m above sea level) of the glacier.

table:columns.name: zmax_m
table:columns.description: Maximum elevation (m above sea level) of the glacier.

table:columns.name: zmed_m
table:columns.description: Median elevation (m above sea level) of the glacier.

table:columns.name: zmean_m
table:columns.description: Mean elevation (m above sea level) of the glacier.

table:columns.name: slope_deg
table:columns.description: Mean slope of the glacier surface.

table:columns.name: aspect_deg
table:columns.description: The aspect (orientation) of the glacier surface presented as an azimuth relative to 0° at due north.

table:columns.name: aspect_sec
table:columns.description: The aspect (orientation) of the glacier surface presented as a category. For a categories description, see user guide.

table:columns.name: dem_source
table:columns.description: The name of the dataset that was used to compute the topography attributes.

classification:classes.name: aster--an-alternative-product-where-the-copernicus-dem-is-not-available
classification:classes.description: ASTER, an alternative product where the Copernicus DEM is not available

classification:classes.name: dem3--an-alternative-product-where-the-copernicus-dem-is-not-available
classification:classes.description: DEM3, an alternative product where the Copernicus DEM is not available

classification:classes.name: ramp--an-alternative-product-where-the-copernicus-dem-is-not-available
classification:classes.description: RAMP, an alternative product where the Copernicus DEM is not available

classification:classes.name: tandem--an-alternative-product-where-the-copernicus-dem-is-not-available
classification:classes.description: TANDEM, an alternative product where the Copernicus DEM is not available

table:columns.name: lmax_m
table:columns.description: Length (m) of the longest surface centerline of the glacier.

table:columns.name: display_name
table:columns.description: Derived from glac_name for map labels: inventory codes such as CN5Y673P0037 removed, names in capitals re-cased, and placeholders such as S/N set to null. Null when no usable name is left. glac_name keeps RGI's value. The rules are in docs/PROVENANCE.md.

table:columns.name: complex_id
table:columns.description: The rgi_id of the glacier complex that holds this glacier, from the CtoG_links.json file of the glacier complex product. That file links "the glacier complex to the glacier products, in a JSON dictionary".

table:columns.name: hypso_z0_m
table:columns.description: Central elevation of the first band of hypso_permille, in m. The band n has the central elevation hypso_z0_m + 50 * n. "The elevation bands are all 50 m in height."

table:columns.name: hypso_permille
table:columns.description: The glacier's hypsometry from the hypsometry.csv file: "elevation-band areas in the form of integer thousandths of the glacier's total area in km² (area_km2)". The values sum to 1000. Empty bands below the lowest and above the highest glacierized band are left out.

table:columns.name: rgi6_links
table:columns.type: list<element: struct<rgi6_id: string, rgi7_reg: string, rgi6_reg: string, overlap_area_km2: double, rgi7_area_fraction: double, rgi6_area_fraction: double, cluster_id: int32, n_rgi7: int32, n_rgi6: int32>>
table:columns.description: The overlaps with RGI 6.0 outlines from the corrected rgi6_links.csv file, one struct per overlap, empty when there is none. The file lists "all overlaps (greater than 200 m²) between pairs of RGI 7.0 and RGI 6.0 glacier outlines". Fields: rgi6_id, rgi7_reg, rgi6_reg, overlap_area_km2, rgi7_area_fraction (overlap divided by the RGI 7.0 area), rgi6_area_fraction (overlap divided by the RGI 6.0 area), cluster_id, n_rgi7 (RGI 7.0 outlines that overlap the RGI 6.0 outline) and n_rgi6 (RGI 6.0 outlines that overlap the RGI 7.0 outline).

table:columns.name: subm_n_outlines
table:columns.description: "Number of outlines from this submission used in RGI 7.0." From the submission_info.csv file of the glacier's first-order region, so it counts the outlines of that region.

table:columns.name: subm_anlys_time
table:columns.description: "Representative time the outline analysis was carried out."

table:columns.name: subm_release_dt
table:columns.description: "Date at which the submission was realeased on GLIMS."

table:columns.name: subm_proc_desc
table:columns.description: "Description of the processing done to create the glacier outlines."

table:columns.name: subm_chief_affl
table:columns.description: "Affiliation of the chief of the regional center or the person(s) who submitted the data."

table:columns.name: subm_submitters
table:columns.description: "Person(s) who submitted the data."

table:columns.name: subm_analysts
table:columns.description: "Person(s) who created the data."

table:columns.name: subm_rc_id
table:columns.description: "GLIMS ID for the regional center."

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Glacier geometry (Polygon)

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), the GeoParquet covering column. Readers use it to skip row groups in a spatial filter.

style-median-elevation.title: Median elevation
style-median-elevation.description: Glaciers by median elevation (zmed_m), in 1,000 m classes.

style-terminus-type.title: Terminus type
style-terminus-type.description: Glaciers by terminus type (term_type). RGI 7.0 assigns only the marine-terminating class.

style-same-as-rgi6.title: Same as RGI 6.0
style-same-as-rgi6.description: Glaciers by whether the outline is the same as in RGI 6.0 (is_rgi6), as in the map of the RGI 7.0 user guide.

thumbnail.title: Thumbnail
thumbnail.description: The default style of the data, drawn by chiitiler. The world views show the land of Natural Earth, which is in the public domain. The glacier products share one frame, the Garibaldi and Marinelli glaciers in the Cordillera Darwin, on white.
